160	
161	    /// The gradient fill (§5.2's `shape.gradient`, format version 6): a
162	    /// geometry, an angle and the stops, all of it one `set_shape` patch.
163	    ///
164	    /// Three rules out of the schema show up here as UI, and none of them is
165	    /// this file's invention:
166	    ///
167	    ///  - **Every write sends the WHOLE object.** The core MERGES a nested
168	    ///    object into a stored one key by key (§5.2), but a stored `null` is
169	    ///    not an object: `actions::merge` replaces it with what the patch
170	    ///    carries, and the keys left out then come from `Gradient::default()`
171	    ///    rather than from what the clip had. This section is where a
172	    ///    gradient is turned ON from null, so it sends every key and is right
173	    ///    in both cases. `shadow` has carried that since M3 and `obscure`
174	    ///    since phase 3; `edited` below is where `gradient` joins them.
175	    ///  - **The Fill rows above stay live.** A gradient takes precedence over
176	    ///    `fill` and does not clear it, which is what makes this section's
177	    ///    Reset — one `{gradient: null}` — an exact inverse rather than a
178	    ///    shape that goes invisible. Disabling the colour underneath would
179	    ///    hide the value the Reset is about to bring back, so the note says
180	    ///    where the fill went instead of the panel pretending it is gone.
181	    ///  - **`line` and `arrow` get the rows DISABLED, not hidden.** The field
182	    ///    is stored and range-checked on every kind and read by the two area
183	    ///    kinds alone — `radius`'s precedent exactly — so flipping the Kind
184	    ///    popup to Line and back may not lose the ramp.
185	    func gradientSection() -> InspectorSection {
186	        let binding = self.binding
187	        let kinds = GradientKind.allCases
188	        func current() -> Gradient? { binding.shapeProps.gradient }
189	        func on() -> Bool { current() != nil }
190	        /// Whether this kind has an interior to fill at all.
191	        func area() -> Bool { !binding.shapeProps.kind.isLinear }
192	        func list() -> [GradientStop] { current()?.stops ?? [] }
193	        func at(_ index: Int) -> GradientStop? {
194	            let stops = list()
195	            return stops.indices.contains(index) ? stops[index] : nil
196	        }
197	        func ops(_ next: Gradient?) -> [ReelOp] {
198	            binding.ops(shape: ShapePatch(gradient: .some(next)))
199	        }
200	        /// The gradient with `change` applied and the other keys as they
201	        /// stand. This is the "send it whole" rule above, spelled once so that
202	        /// no row has to remember it.
203	        func edited(_ change: (inout Gradient) -> Void) -> [ReelOp] {
204	            guard var gradient = current() else { return [] }
205	            change(&gradient)
206	            return ops(gradient)
207	        }
208	        func edited(replacing index: Int, _ stop: GradientStop) -> [ReelOp] {
209	            var next = list()
210	            guard next.indices.contains(index) else { return [] }
211	            next[index] = stop
212	            return edited { $0.stops = next }
213	        }
214	        /// The mixed badge for one stop's field: a selection where some clip
215	        /// has no gradient, or none at that index, disagrees — which the
216	        /// `nil` says, the way `obscureSection`'s `mixedAt` says it.
217	        func mixedAt<T: Equatable>(_ index: Int, _ read: @escaping (GradientStop) -> T) -> Bool {
218	            binding.mixedShape { props -> T? in
219	                guard let stops = props.gradient?.stops, stops.indices.contains(index)
220	                else { return nil }
221	                return read(stops[index])
222	            }
223	        }
224	        /// The colour half way between two stops, component by component —
225	        /// which is exactly what `CGGradient` does between them, in the same
226	        /// sRGB space, so a handle added here sits ON the ramp rather than
227	        /// beside it. A three-component colour is an opaque one (`RGBA`'s own
228	        /// rule), so both are padded the same way before they are mixed.
229	        func midpoint(_ a: RGBA, _ b: RGBA) -> RGBA {
230	            func component(_ color: RGBA, _ index: Int) -> Double {
231	                index < color.count ? color[index] : (index == 3 ? 1 : 0)
232	            }
233	            return (0..<4).map { (component(a, $0) + component(b, $0)) / 2 }
234	        }
235	        /// A stop dropped into the WIDEST gap and coloured by the ramp that
236	        /// is already there, so Add changes the picture not at all: it puts a
237	        /// handle where the ramp already runs, which is what Add means in
238	        /// every gradient editor. The model cannot do this for you —
239	        /// `GradientStop`'s own default is black at 0, because serde has to
240	        /// fill a missing key without knowing which row was clicked.
241	        ///
242	        /// It inserts into the list as it is HELD, never into the sorted one.
243	        /// The rows are drawn in held order and the core deliberately does
244	        /// not police that order (`props_check.rs` argues the missing check
245	        /// where it would have gone), so sorting here would make every row
246	        /// jump the first time somebody pressed Add.
247	        func added(_ stops: [GradientStop]) -> [GradientStop] {
248	            guard stops.count >= 2 else { return Gradient.defaultStops }
249	            let ramp = stops.enumerated().sorted {
250	                $0.element.at == $1.element.at
251	                    ? $0.offset < $1.offset : $0.element.at < $1.element.at
252	            }
253	            var widest = -1.0
254	            var left = ramp[0]
255	            var right = ramp[1]
256	            for (a, b) in zip(ramp, ramp.dropFirst()) where b.element.at - a.element.at > widest {
257	                widest = b.element.at - a.element.at
258	                left = a
259	                right = b
260	            }
261	            var next = stops
262	            next.insert(
263	                GradientStop(
264	                    at: (left.element.at + right.element.at) / 2,
265	                    color: midpoint(left.element.color, right.element.color)),
266	                at: left.offset + 1)
267	            return next
268	        }
269	
270	        var rows: [NSView] = [
271	            inspectorCheckRow(
272	                "Gradient", binding, name: "Gradient", read: on,
273	                ops: { value in ops(value ? Gradient() : nil) },
274	                mixed: { binding.mixedShape { $0.gradient != nil } },
275	                enabled: area),
276	            inspectorPopupRow(
277	                "Kind", binding, name: "Gradient Kind", items: kinds.map { $0.displayName },
278	                read: { kinds.firstIndex(of: current()?.kind ?? .linear) ?? 0 },
279	                ops: { index in
280	                    guard kinds.indices.contains(index) else { return [] }
281	                    return edited { $0.kind = kinds[index] }
282	                },
283	                mixed: { binding.mixedShape { $0.gradient?.kind } },
284	                enabled: { on() && area() }),
285	            // Degrees from the RIGHT, counter-clockwise, and the same eight
286	            // quick picks the shadow's angle gets, because it is the same
287	            // convention and the crate has only the one.
288	            inspectorValueRow(
289	                "Angle", binding, name: "Gradient Angle", unit: "°", decimals: 0, min: 0,
290	                max: 360, quick: [0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315],
291	                read: { current()?.angle ?? 0 },
292	                ops: { v in edited { $0.angle = v } },
293	                mixed: { binding.mixedShape { $0.gradient?.angle } },
294	                // A radial gradient has no direction to point: the model
295	                // stores the angle through the flip all the same, so coming
296	                // back to Linear finds the number where it was left.
297	                enabled: { on() && area() && current()?.kind == .linear }),
298	        ]
299	        for index in 0..<list().count {
300	            let swatch = OptionSwatchControl(
301	                read: { at(index)?.color.nsColor ?? .black },
302	                write: { color in
303	                    guard let stop = at(index),
304	                        let next = changedRGBA(color, from: stop.color)
305	                    else { return }
306	                    binding.apply(
307	                        "Gradient Stop",
308	                        edited(replacing: index, GradientStop(at: stop.at, color: next)))
309	                },
310	                enabled: area, onEdit: {})
311	            // A stop's position is 0–1 in the model and a PERCENTAGE here,
312	            // for `video.opacity`'s reason: the ramp is a distance across the
313	            // box, and nobody reads 0.35 of a box as a third of the way.
314	            let position = OptionFieldControl(
315	                width: InspectorMetrics.fieldWidth, unit: "%", decimals: 0, min: 0, max: 100,
316	                quick: [0, 25, 50, 75, 100],
317	                read: { (at(index)?.at ?? 0) * 100 },
318	                write: { value in
319	                    guard let stop = at(index) else { return }
320	                    binding.apply(
321	                        "Gradient Stop",
322	                        edited(replacing: index, GradientStop(at: value / 100, color: stop.color)))
323	                },
324	                enabled: area,
325	                onEdit: { binding.edited() })
326	            let remove = OptionButtonControl(
327	                title: "Remove",
328	                action: {
329	                    var next = list()
330	                    guard next.count > 2, next.indices.contains(index) else {
331	                        NSSound.beep()
332	                        return
333	                    }
334	                    next.remove(at: index)
335	                    binding.apply("Remove Stop", edited { $0.stops = next })
336	                },
337	                enabled: { area() && list().count > 2 }, onEdit: {})
338	            remove.toolTip =
339	                "Take this colour off the ramp — two stops is the floor, because one "
340	                + "colour is a fill and Fill above already spells that"
341	            rows.append(
342	                inspectorRow(
343	                    "Stop \(index + 1)", [swatch, position, remove],
344	                    mixed: { mixedAt(index) { $0.color } || mixedAt(index) { $0.at } }))
345	        }
346	        if !on() {
347	            rows.append(inspectorRow(nil, [InspectorRowLabel("No gradient.")]))
348	        }
349	        let add = OptionButtonControl(
350	            title: "Add Stop",
351	            action: {
352	                let next = added(list())
353	                guard next.count > list().count else {
354	                    NSSound.beep()
355	                    return
356	                }
357	                binding.apply("Add Stop", edited { $0.stops = next })
358	            },
359	            enabled: { area() && on() && list().count < Gradient.maxStops }, onEdit: {})
360	        add.toolTip =
361	            "Put a handle on the ramp where the ramp already is — the widest gap, "
362	            + "at the colour that is already there"
363	        rows.append(inspectorButtonRow([add, InspectorRowLabel("\(Gradient.maxStops) at most")]))
364	
365	        return InspectorSection(
366	            id: "shape.gradient", title: "Gradient",
367	            summary: {
368	                guard let gradient = current() else { return "off" }
369	                return "\(gradient.kind.displayName.lowercased()), \(gradient.stops.count) stops"
370	            },
371	            note: {
372	                guard area() else {
373	                    return "Fills the rectangle or ellipse; a line or arrow keeps its "
374	                        + "stroke colour."
375	                }
376	                guard on(), binding.shapeProps.fill != nil else { return nil }
377	                return "The gradient covers the Fill colour above; Reset brings it back."
378	            },
379	            reset: { binding.apply("Gradient", shape: ShapePatch(gradient: .some(nil))) },
380	            defaultExpanded: false,
381	            rows: rows)
382	    }

2	// 10 §5j, G5a): Source (in `GraphicPane+Source.swift`), Properties from the
3	// module's schema (rows from `GraphicSchemaRows.swift`), Size and Timeline.
4	// With no action selected every write is `set_graphic`. With one selected, a
5	// Properties write — Reset's included — goes to the action's END with the
6	// module's current schema, one `set_action_end` naming `graphic.props.<key>`,
7	// except an `animate: false` prop's, which stays the clip's (spec §11 G-34
8	// (l), G-41 (d), G-42 (d)); Size and
9	// Timeline still write `set_graphic`, so their rows are ⊘. The core
10	// validates both.
11	//
12	// **Never shown itself**: like `ShapePane`, a factory `ClipPane` holds and
13	// calls when EVERY selected clip is a graphic clip.
14	//
15	// **Several graphic clips.** Source and Size always; Properties only when
16	// every clip is drawn by ONE module (one schema to build rows from, and the
17	// schema `set_graphic` needs), and Timeline only for one clip — its `in`
18	// and `length` are that clip's own. With different modules Source says so
19	// and names them (spec §11 G-15).
20	//
21	// **The schema is the registry's** (`GraphicRegistry.entry(named:for:)`,
22	// main only), the same read `AgentServer+Graphics.compiledModule` makes for
23	// the tool path. Nothing here rescans the store from an observer: `drain()`
24	// is not re-entrant (road map 10 §10.6 G3a).

38	final class GraphicPane: InspectorPaneView {
39	    /// The report of each module/revision/library/frame hash/size seen, and
40	    /// the last report per clip — what a miss answers while a live gesture
41	    /// runs, so the signature holds still through a drag.
42	    var reportMemo: [String: GraphicClipReport] = [:]
43	    var lastReports: [UInt32: GraphicClipReport] = [:]
44	    /// The parsed schema of the last module asked, keyed "name|revision".
45	    var schemaMemo: (key: String, schema: GraphicSchema)?
46	    /// Each clip's recipe layer source under `layerProject`, the handle it
47	    /// was read from; emptied when the binding's project is another handle.
48	    weak var layerProject: ReelProject?
49	    var layerMemo: [UInt32: RecipeSourceRef] = [:]
50	
51	    /// Whether the graphic sections apply: they write `set_graphic`, which
52	    /// errors on any other kind, so a mixed selection gets none of them.
53	    var allGraphic: Bool {
54	        !binding.clips.isEmpty && binding.graphicClips.count == binding.clips.count
55	    }
56	
57	    /// The one module every selected graphic clip is drawn by.
58	    struct Shared {
59	        let name: String
60	        let file: GraphicModuleFile?
61	        let entry: GraphicRegistry.Entry?
62	    }
63	
64	    /// nil when the selection's modules differ (or it holds no graphic).
65	    func shared() -> Shared? {
66	        let names = Set(binding.graphicClips.compactMap { $0.graphic?.name })
67	        guard names.count == 1, let name = names.first else { return nil }
68	        let document = binding.document
69	        return Shared(
70	            name: name, file: document?.graphicStore?.module(named: name),
71	            entry: document.flatMap {
72	                GraphicRegistry.shared.entry(named: name, for: $0.recipeKey)
73	            })
74	    }
75	
76	    /// The compiled schema of `shared`, parsed in the module's order, and
77	    /// the registry's dictionary the ops carry. Parsed once per name and
78	    /// revision (`schemaMemo`).
79	    func schema(_ shared: Shared?) -> (schema: GraphicSchema, raw: [String: Any])? {
80	        guard let shared, case .compiled(let module, let revision, _, let raw)? = shared.entry
81	        else { return nil }
82	        let key = "\(shared.name)|\(revision)"
83	        if let memo = schemaMemo, memo.key == key { return (memo.schema, raw) }
84	        let parsed = GraphicSchema(describeJSON: module.describeJSON(), schema: raw)
85	        schemaMemo = (key, parsed)
86	        return (parsed, raw)
87	    }

89	    /// The selection's stored props, merged; the first clip holding a key wins.
90	    func storedProps() -> [String: GraphicPropValue] {
91	        var merged: [String: GraphicPropValue] = [:]
92	        for clip in binding.graphicClips {
93	            merged.merge(clip.graphic?.props ?? [:]) { first, _ in first }
94	        }
95	        return merged
96	    }

98	    /// The selected action's end props (G-34 (a)); none with no action
99	    /// selected. Its keys the schema lacks are the action's stale rows.
100	    func endProps() -> [String: GraphicPropValue] {
101	        binding.selectedAction?.end.graphic?.props ?? [:]
102	    }
103	
104	    /// The asset folder's file names, sorted.
105	    func assetNames() -> [String] {
106	        (binding.document?.graphicStore?.scan.assets.map(\.name) ?? []).sorted()
107	    }
108	
109	    /// What the graphics folder's scan skipped or could not watch, in its own
110	    /// sentences — the Source section's folder rows (G-24 (b)).
111	    func folderWarnings() -> [String] {
112	        binding.document?.graphicStore?.scan.warnings ?? []
113	    }
114	
115	    /// The schema's entries whole (a default, bounds or options a row is
116	    /// built from), the stale keys (the clip's, then the selected action's
117	    /// end's, `actionStaleKeys`, a declared key no action may animate
118	    /// included, G-41), each asset popup's names (the selected end's
119	    /// included, G-42), the
120	    /// diagnostics' messages and the folder's warnings. Stored values, the
121	    /// revision and the playhead are NOT here: they are read fresh by
122	    /// `refresh()`.
123	    override var structureSignature: String {
124	        guard allGraphic else { return super.structureSignature + "|-" }
125	        let shared = self.shared()
126	        let parsed = schema(shared)
127	        let keys = parsed?.schema.entries.map { String(describing: $0) } ?? []
128	        let stale = GraphicSchemaRows.staleKeys(stored: storedProps(), schema: parsed?.schema)
129	        var messages = ["-", "-"]
130	        if let shared, let clip = binding.graphicClips.first, let document = binding.document {
131	            let version = GraphicRegistry.shared.snapshot(for: document.recipeKey)?.libraryVersion
132	            let report = self.report(for: clip, shared, libraryVersion: version ?? "")
133	            func spell(_ list: [GraphicDiagnostic]) -> String {
134	                list.map { "\($0.level):\($0.line ?? -1):\($0.column ?? -1):\($0.message)" }
135	                    .joined(separator: "¶")
136	            }
137	            messages = [spell(report.compile), spell(report.render)]
138	        }
139	        messages.append(folderWarnings().joined(separator: "¶"))
140	        return [
141	            super.structureSignature, shared?.name ?? "mixed", keys.joined(separator: ","),
142	            stale.joined(separator: ","), assetSignature(parsed?.schema),
143	            GraphicSchemaRows.actionStaleKeys(end: endProps(), schema: parsed?.schema)
144	                .joined(separator: ","),
145	        ].joined(separator: "|") + "|" + messages.joined(separator: "|")
146	    }

148	    /// Each asset entry's popup names, from the rows' own
149	    /// `GraphicSchemaRows.assetNames` call, the selected action's end's names
150	    /// counting (G-42 (d)): names joined by ",", entries by ";".
151	    private func assetSignature(_ schema: GraphicSchema?) -> String {
152	        let files = assetNames(), clips = binding.graphicClips
153	        return (schema?.entries ?? []).filter { $0.type == "asset" }.map {
154	            GraphicSchemaRows.assetNames(for: $0, files: files, clips: clips, end: endProps())
155	                .joined(separator: ",")

161	    /// One row per schema key in the module's order, then the stale keys,
162	    /// sorted, then — with an action selected — the end's own stale keys
163	    /// (G-34 (l), O2), a declared key whose entry is not `animatable` among
164	    /// them (G-41 (c)). With no compiled schema every stored key is stale.
165	    /// Reset nulls every stored key; with an action selected it writes each
166	    /// declared default through the rows' own split, into the END (an
167	    /// asset's `null` as `""`, G-42 (d)), an `animate: false` prop's (G-41
168	    /// (d)) onto the clip (O7). Its `differs` folds from the rows.
169	    func propertiesSection() -> InspectorSection {
170	        let binding = self.binding
171	        let shared = self.shared()
172	        let parsed = schema(shared)
173	        let clips = { binding.graphicClips }
174	        let assets = { [weak self] in self?.assetNames() ?? [] }
175	        var rows: [NSView] = parsed?.schema.entries.map {
176	            GraphicSchemaRows.row(
177	                $0, binding, clips: clips, schema: parsed?.raw ?? [:], assets: assets)
178	        } ?? []
179	        let stored = storedProps()
180	        for key in GraphicSchemaRows.staleKeys(stored: stored, schema: parsed?.schema) {
181	            rows.append(
182	                GraphicSchemaRows.staleRow(
183	                    key: key, value: stored[key] ?? .null, binding, clips: clips))
184	        }
185	        let ends = endProps()
186	        let declared = Set(parsed?.schema.keys ?? [])
187	        for key in GraphicSchemaRows.actionStaleKeys(end: ends, schema: parsed?.schema) {
188	            rows.append(
189	                GraphicSchemaRows.actionStaleRow(
190	                    key: key, value: ends[key] ?? .null, declared: declared.contains(key), binding))
191	        }
192	        let note: String?
193	        if parsed == nil {
194	            note = "The module did not compile — see Source. Stored values are listed below."
195	        } else if parsed?.schema.entries.isEmpty == true {
196	            note = "The module declares no properties."
197	        } else {
198	            note = nil
199	        }
200	        let count = parsed?.schema.entries.count ?? 0
201	        return InspectorSection(
202	            id: "graphic.properties", title: "Properties",
203	            summary: { count == 1 ? "1 property" : "\(count) properties" },
204	            note: note.map { text -> () -> String? in { text } },
205	            reset: {
206	                if binding.selectedAction != nil {
207	                    let entries = parsed?.schema.entries ?? []
208	                    let defaults = Dictionary(
209	                        entries.map { ($0.key, $0.default) }, uniquingKeysWith: { first, _ in first })
210	                    binding.apply(
211	                        "Reset Graphic Properties",
212	                        binding.ops(
213	                            graphic: defaults, entries: entries, clips: clips(), schema: parsed?.raw))

140	    /// The module's compile, and `clip`'s first frame drawn and rasterized at
141	    /// the clip's own size — through the memo, and never recomputed while a
142	    /// live gesture runs.
143	    func report(
144	        for clip: ClipSnapshot, _ shared: Shared, libraryVersion: String
145	    ) -> GraphicClipReport {
146	        let module: GraphicModule, revision: String
147	        switch shared.entry {
148	        case nil:
149	            return GraphicClipReport(
150	                compile: [GraphicDiagnostic.noModule(shared.name)],
151	                render: [], frame: nil)
152	        case .failed(let diagnostics, _)?:
153	            return GraphicClipReport(compile: diagnostics, render: [], frame: nil)
154	        case .compiled(let compiled, let hash, _, _)?:
155	            module = compiled
156	            revision = hash
157	        }
158	        guard let graphic = clip.graphic, let document = binding.document else { return .empty }
159	        if document.isLiveEditing { return lastReports[clip.id] ?? .empty }
160	        guard let set = GraphicRegistry.shared.snapshot(for: document.recipeKey),
161	              let source = layerSource(of: clip),
162	              case .graphic(_, let hash, let frame, let propsJSON, let ctxJSON) = source
163	        else { return .empty }
164	        let key = [
165	            shared.name, revision, libraryVersion, hash, "\(graphic.width)×\(graphic.height)",
166	        ].joined(separator: "|")
167	        if let hit = reportMemo[key] {
168	            lastReports[clip.id] = hit
169	            return hit
170	        }
171	        var render: [GraphicDiagnostic] = []
172	        do {
173	            let drawn = try module.svg(
174	                frame: frame, propsJSON: propsJSON, ctxJSON: ctxJSON,
175	                budgetMs: GraphicRegistry.previewBudgetMs)
176	            render += drawn.warnings
177	            do {
178	                let raster = try set.library.rasterize(
179	                    drawn.svg, width: graphic.width, height: graphic.height)
180	                render += raster.warnings
181	            } catch {
182	                render += GraphicDiagnostic.of(error)
183	            }
184	        } catch {
185	            render += GraphicDiagnostic.of(error)
186	        }
187	        let report = GraphicClipReport(
188	            compile: module.compileWarnings, render: render, frame: frame)
189	        if reportMemo.count >= 64 { reportMemo.removeAll() }
190	        reportMemo[key] = report
191	        lastReports[clip.id] = report
192	        return report
193	    }

196	    /// `layerMemo`: `recipe(at:)` is asked only on a miss, and the memo is
197	    /// emptied when the binding's project is another handle.
198	    func layerSource(of clip: ClipSnapshot) -> RecipeSourceRef? {
199	        guard let project = binding.project else { return nil }
200	        if project !== layerProject {
201	            layerMemo = [:]
202	            layerProject = project
203	        }
204	        if let hit = layerMemo[clip.id] { return hit }
205	        guard let layer = project.recipe(at: clip.start)?.layers
206	            .first(where: { $0.clip == clip.id })
207	        else { return nil }
208	        layerMemo[clip.id] = layer.source
209	        return layer.source
210	    }

217	        guard let store = binding.document?.graphicStore else { return NSSound.beep() }
218	        let suggestion = store.uniqueModuleName(file.name + "-copy")
219	        let alert = NSAlert()

222	        alert.informativeText =

224	            + "are drawn by it. Writing the file cannot be undone; switching the clips can."
225	        let field = NSTextField(string: suggestion)
226	        field.frame = NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 240, height: 24)
227	        field.placeholderString = "Module name"
228	        alert.accessoryView = field
229	        alert.addButton(withTitle: "Duplicate")
230	        alert.addButton(withTitle: "Cancel")
231	        alert.window.initialFirstResponder = field
232	        guard alert.runModal() == .alertFirstButtonReturn else { return }
233	        let name = field.stringValue.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
234	        func refuse(_ sentence: String) {
235	            NSAlert(error: NSError(
236	                domain: "FrameJob", code: 1, userInfo: [NSLocalizedDescriptionKey: sentence]))
237	                .runModal()
238	        }
239	        guard GraphicStore.isModuleName(name) else { return refuse(GraphicStore.nameSentence(name)) }
240	        guard !store.holdsModule(named: name) else {
241	            return refuse("graphics/\(name).js already exists")
242	        }
243	        do {

245	        } catch {
246	            return refuse("graphics/\(name).js could not be written: \(error.localizedDescription)")

249	        let clips = binding.graphicClips.map(\.id)
250	        binding.apply(
251	            "Duplicate Graphic",
252	            clips.isEmpty ? [] : [.setGraphicRaw(clips: clips, patch: ["name": name], schema: schema)])

78	/// The colour as the model's RGBA, or nil when it already matches `current`.
79	///
80	/// **Pitfall:** the shared colour panel is continuous, so a drag inside it
81	/// calls a swatch's writer on every mouse-moved event — including with the
82	/// colour it already has. Without this guard the document would answer an
83	/// unchanged edit with a refusal beep on every one of them.
84	func changedRGBA(_ color: NSColor, from current: RGBA) -> RGBA? {
85	    let next = color.rgbaComponents
86	    guard next.count == current.count else { return next }
87	    for (a, b) in zip(next, current) where abs(a - b) > 0.001 { return next }
88	    return nil

93	/// One sub-tab of the Clip tab (spec §11 CI-5). The case order is the display
94	/// order: Text and Shape come first for those kinds, Clip is always last.
95	enum ClipSubTab: String, CaseIterable {
96	    case text, shape, graphic, picture, color, sound, clip
97	
98	    var title: String {
99	        switch self {
100	        case .text: return "Text"
101	        case .shape: return "Shape"
102	        case .graphic: return "Graphic"
103	        case .picture: return "Picture"
104	        case .color: return "Color"
105	        case .sound: return "Sound"
106	        case .clip: return "Clip"
107	        }
108	    }
109	
110	    /// The `◆N` badge (spec §11 CI-6): how many KEYS of an action's end patch
111	    /// this tab's sections write. Motion lives on Clip, so Picture counts the
112	    /// video keys without it; a shape's props are not animatable; Graphic
113	    /// counts the end's `graphic.props`, a key its module no longer declares
114	    /// included (CI-6 amended, G-34 (l)). Color counts `color`, one key
115	    /// however many of its thirteen the end names, and Picture no longer does
116	    /// (CI-6 amended by GR-2); for an all-adjustment selection (`adjustment`)
117	    /// it also counts `opacity`, the Adjustment section's Strength (GR-6). An
118	    /// end's `look` is Color's too, one key (GR-7), and so is its `wheels`,
119	    /// one key however many of its nine it names (GR-11), and its `curves`,
120	    /// one key however many channels it names (GR-12), and its `qualifier`,
121	    /// one key however many ranges it names (GR-13); Picture counts none of
122	    /// them. Clip also counts an end's `speed`, the Speed section's Rate (CI-6
123	    /// amended by SR-21).
124	    func keyedCount(in end: ActionPatch, adjustment: Bool = false) -> Int {
125	        switch self {
126	        case .text: return end.text?.dictionary.count ?? 0
127	        case .shape: return 0
128	        case .graphic: return end.graphic?.props.count ?? 0
129	        case .picture:
130	            let other: Set<String> = ["motion", "color", "look", "wheels", "curves", "qualifier"]
131	            return end.video?.dictionary.keys.filter { !other.contains($0) }.count ?? 0
132	        case .color:
133	            return (end.video?.color?.isEmpty == false ? 1 : 0)
134	                + (end.video?.dictionary["look"] != nil ? 1 : 0)
135	                + (end.video?.wheels?.isEmpty == false ? 1 : 0)
136	                + (end.video?.curves?.isEmpty == false ? 1 : 0)
137	                + (end.video?.qualifier?.isEmpty == false ? 1 : 0)
138	                + (adjustment && end.video?.dictionary["opacity"] != nil ? 1 : 0)
139	        case .sound: return end.audio?.dictionary.count ?? 0
140	        case .clip:
141	            return (end.video?.dictionary["motion"] == nil ? 0 : 1) + (end.speed == nil ? 0 : 1)
142	        }
143	    }
144	}

157	    let active: ClipSubTab
158	    private let badge: (ClipSubTab) -> Int
159	    private let onSelect: (ClipSubTab) -> Void
160	    private var badges: [Int] = []

162	    init(
163	        tabs: [ClipSubTab], active: ClipSubTab, badge: @escaping (ClipSubTab) -> Int,
164	        onSelect: @escaping (ClipSubTab) -> Void
165	    ) {
166	        self.tabs = tabs
167	        self.active = active
168	        self.badge = badge
169	        self.onSelect = onSelect
170	        super.init(frame: .zero)
171	        wantsLayer = true
172	        badges = tabs.map(badge)
173	    }
174	
175	    @available(*, unavailable)
176	    required init?(coder: NSCoder) {
177	        fatalError("ClipSubTabsView does not support NSCoder")
178	    }

180	    override var isFlipped: Bool { true }
181	
182	    override var intrinsicContentSize: NSSize {
183	        NSSize(width: NSView.noIntrinsicMetric, height: Self.top + Self.cell + Self.bottom)
184	    }

186	    /// Equal cells, each sharing its left border with the previous one's
187	    /// right (a −1 overlap), with `PanelTabsView.tabRect`'s rounding so the
188	    /// row tiles exactly.
189	    func cellRect(_ index: Int) -> CGRect {
190	        let step = (bounds.width - 2 * Self.side - 1) / CGFloat(max(tabs.count, 1))
191	        let left = Self.side + (CGFloat(index) * step).rounded()
192	        let right = Self.side + (CGFloat(index + 1) * step).rounded() + 1
193	        return CGRect(x: left, y: Self.top, width: right - left, height: Self.cell)
194	    }

196	    /// Re-reads the badges; redraws only when they changed.
197	    func refresh() {
198	        let next = tabs.map(badge)
199	        guard next != badges else { return }
200	        badges = next
201	        needsDisplay = true
202	    }

204	    override func mouseDown(with event: NSEvent) {
205	        let point = convert(event.locationInWindow, from: nil)
206	        guard let index = tabs.indices.first(where: { cellRect($0).contains(point) }),
207	              tabs[index] != active
208	        else { return }
209	        onSelect(tabs[index])
210	    }
211	
212	    override func draw(_ dirtyRect: NSRect) {
213	        DS.border.setFill()
214	        NSRect(x: 0, y: bounds.height - 1, width: bounds.width, height: 1).fill()
215	        // The active cell last, so its accent border wins the shared edges.
216	        let order = tabs.indices.filter { tabs[$0] != active }
217	            + tabs.indices.filter { tabs[$0] == active }
218	        for index in order {
219	            drawCell(index)
220	        }
221	    }
222	
223	    private func drawCell(_ index: Int) {
224	        let rect = cellRect(index)
225	        let isActive = tabs[index] == active
226	        (isActive ? DS.selectionFill : NSColor.controlBackgroundColor).setFill()
227	        rect.fill()
228	        (isActive ? DS.accent : DS.border).setStroke()
229	        NSBezierPath(rect: rect.insetBy(dx: 0.5, dy: 0.5)).stroke()
230	
231	        let label = NSAttributedString(
232	            string: tabs[index].title,
233	            attributes: [
234	                .font: DS.sans(11, weight: .semibold),
235	                .foregroundColor: isActive ? DS.textStrong : DS.textMuted,
236	            ])
237	        let count = badges.indices.contains(index) ? badges[index] : 0
238	        let mark = count > 0
239	            ? NSAttributedString(
240	                string: "◆\(count)",
241	                attributes: [.font: DS.mono(9, weight: .medium), .foregroundColor: DS.action])
242	            : nil
243	        let labelSize = label.size()
244	        let markSize = mark?.size() ?? .zero
245	        let gap: CGFloat = mark == nil ? 0 : 4
246	        let width = ceil(labelSize.width) + gap + ceil(markSize.width)
247	        let x = (rect.midX - width / 2).rounded()
248	        label.draw(at: NSPoint(x: x, y: rect.midY - labelSize.height / 2))
249	        mark?.draw(
250	            at: NSPoint(
251	                x: x + ceil(labelSize.width) + gap, y: rect.midY - markSize.height / 2))
252	    }
253	}

573	/// The selected clip's actions as a mini timeline (spec §11 CI-1, CI-4):
574	/// a header row (ACTIONS, the count, "· editing N", and Zoom to Region, Zoom
575	/// Back and Add Action), a lane row (the Clip chip, then the whole clip with
576	/// its bands by fraction, numbered in time order, and the playhead), and —
577	/// only while an action is selected — a detail row: Start (clip-relative),
578	/// Length, Curve and Remove, each an ordinary `set_action` / `remove_action`.
579	///
580	/// Built once per pane build; the pane rebuilds whenever the selected clip or
581	/// the selected action changes (the default `structureSignature` keys on
582	/// `InspectorBinding.action(_:)`), so the ids captured here are the ones on
583	/// screen, and every read goes fresh through them.
584	///
585	/// A band is dragged here as on the timeline (spec §11 CI-11,
586	/// `ActionLaneView+Drag.swift`), and the well carries the clip's hatch, fades
587	/// and wedges under the bands (CI-12, `ActionLaneDecor.swift`).
588	final class ActionLaneView: NSView, OptionControl {
589	    static let headerRow: CGFloat = 18, laneRow: CGFloat = 28, detailRow: CGFloat = 22
590	    static let chipWidth: CGFloat = 40
591	    static let top: CGFloat = 8
592	    private static let bottom: CGFloat = 9, gap: CGFloat = 6
593	    static let side = InspectorMetrics.inset
594	
595	    let binding: InspectorBinding
596	    private weak var inspector: InspectorViewController?
597	    /// The single selected clip at build time; nil for a multi-selection.
598	    let clipID: UInt32?
599	    /// The selected action at build time.
600	    let actionID: UInt32?
601	    private let detail = NSView()
602	    private var controls: [any OptionControl] = []
603	
604	    /// The live band drag; nil for a zero-length band, which is never dragged.
605	    var drag: ActionDragSession?
606	    /// The band under the mouse-down — what `releaseBand` selects.
607	    var pressed: UInt32?
608	    /// The band under the pointer while nothing is pressed.
609	    var hover: ActionBandHover? { didSet { if hover != oldValue { needsDisplay = true } } }
610	    /// What the cursor rects were last built from: `refresh()` invalidates
611	    /// them only when this changes, never on a playhead-only refresh.
612	    private var cursorKey:
613	        (clip: UInt32?, bands: [(UInt32, Ticks, Ticks)], frame: Ticks, length: Ticks)?
614	
615	    init(binding: InspectorBinding, inspector: InspectorViewController?) {
616	        self.binding = binding
617	        self.inspector = inspector
618	        let single = binding.isSingle ? binding.primary?.id : nil
619	        clipID = single
620	        actionID = single == nil ? nil : binding.selectedAction?.id
621	        super.init(frame: .zero)
622	        wantsLayer = true
623	        buildButtons()
624	        buildDetail()
625	        refresh()
626	    }
627	
628	    @available(*, unavailable)
629	    required init?(coder: NSCoder) {
630	        fatalError("ActionLaneView does not support NSCoder")
631	    }
632	
633	    override var isFlipped: Bool { true }
634	
635	    override var intrinsicContentSize: NSSize {
636	        var height = Self.top + Self.headerRow + Self.gap + Self.laneRow + Self.bottom
637	        if isDetailRowVisible { height += Self.gap + Self.detailRow }
638	        return NSSize(width: NSView.noIntrinsicMetric, height: height)
639	    }
640	
641	    // MARK: Reads
642	
643	    var clip: ClipSnapshot? { clipID.flatMap { binding.snapshot.clip($0) } }
644	
645	    /// The captured action, while it is still the selected one.
646	    var action: ActionSnapshot? {
647	        guard let id = actionID, binding.selectedAction?.id == id else { return nil }
648	        return clip?.actions.first { $0.id == id }
649	    }
650	
651	    var isDetailRowVisible: Bool { !detail.isHidden }
652	
653	    /// The Clip chip is the active target when no action is selected.
654	    var isClipChipActive: Bool { clipID != nil && action == nil }
655	
656	    // MARK: Geometry
657	
658	    var laneTop: CGFloat { Self.top + Self.headerRow + Self.gap }
659	
660	    var chipRect: CGRect {
661	        CGRect(x: Self.side, y: laneTop, width: Self.chipWidth, height: Self.laneRow)
662	    }
663	
664	    /// The whole clip, from its start to its end.
665	    var laneRect: CGRect {
666	        let x = chipRect.maxX + 4
667	        return CGRect(
668	            x: x, y: laneTop, width: max(bounds.width - Self.side - x, 0), height: Self.laneRow)
669	    }
670	
671	    /// Every band, in time order, by fraction of the clip — inset 4 pt top
672	    /// and bottom, at least 2 pt wide.
673	    func bandRects() -> [(id: UInt32, rect: CGRect)] {
674	        guard let clip = clip, clip.duration > 0 else { return [] }
675	        let lane = laneRect
676	        let span = CGFloat(clip.duration)
677	        return ActionBands.ordered(clip).map { action in
678	            let from = lane.minX + lane.width * CGFloat(action.start) / span
679	            let to = lane.minX + lane.width * CGFloat(action.endTime) / span
680	            return (
681	                action.id,
682	                CGRect(x: from, y: lane.minY + 4, width: max(to - from, 2), height: lane.height - 8)
683	            )
684	        }
685	    }
686	
687	    // MARK: Building
688	
689	    private func buildButtons() {
690	        let specs: [(String, String, String, Selector)] = [
691	            ("plus.magnifyingglass", "+", "Zoom to Region (Z)",
692	             #selector(EditorViewController.zoomToRegion(_:))),
693	            ("minus.magnifyingglass", "−", "Zoom Back",
694	             #selector(EditorViewController.zoomBack(_:))),
695	            ("plus", "+", "Add Action (⌥⌘K)",
696	             #selector(EditorViewController.addActionAtPlayhead(_:))),
697	        ]
698	        var trailing = trailingAnchor
699	        var constant = -Self.side
700	        for (index, spec) in specs.enumerated().reversed() {
701	            let button = GhostButton(
702	                symbol: spec.0, fallback: spec.1, caption: nil, tooltip: spec.2,
703	                action: #selector(buttonPressed(_:)), size: NSSize(width: 20, height: 18),
704	                pointSize: 13)
705	            button.target = self
706	            button.tag = index
707	            button.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
708	            addSubview(button)
709	            NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
710	                button.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: topAnchor, constant: Self.top),
711	                button.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: trailing, constant: constant),
712	            ])
713	            trailing = button.leadingAnchor
714	            constant = -2
715	        }
716	        commands = specs.map { $0.3 }
717	    }
718	
719	    private var commands: [Selector] = []
720	
721	    @objc private func buttonPressed(_ sender: NSButton) {
722	        guard commands.indices.contains(sender.tag) else { return }
723	        inspector?.onCommand?(commands[sender.tag])
724	    }
725	
726	    /// Start · Length · Curve · Remove. Built only for a clip with an action
727	    /// selected; otherwise the row stays empty and hidden.
728	    private func buildDetail() {
729	        detail.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
730	        addSubview(detail)
731	        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
732	            detail.topAnchor.constraint(
733	                equalTo: topAnchor, constant: laneTop + Self.laneRow + Self.gap),
734	            detail.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: leadingAnchor, constant: Self.side),
735	            detail.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: trailingAnchor, constant: -Self.side),
736	            detail.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: Self.detailRow),
737	        ])
738	        guard let clipID, let actionID else { return }
739	        let binding = self.binding
740	        func current() -> ActionSnapshot? {
741	            binding.snapshot.clip(clipID)?.actions.first { $0.id == actionID }
742	        }
743	        func length() -> Ticks { binding.snapshot.clip(clipID)?.duration ?? 0 }
744	        let start = InspectorTimecodeField(
745	            read: { current()?.start ?? 0 },
746	            write: { value in
747	                binding.apply(
748	                    "Move Action",
749	                    [.setAction(clip: clipID, action: actionID, start: min(value, length()))])
750	            },
751	            fps: { binding.canvas.fps }, frames: { binding.canvas.timecodeFrames },
752	            onEdit: { binding.edited() })
753	        start.toolTip = "Where the action starts, from the clip's own start"
754	        let duration = OptionFieldControl(
755	            width: 58, unit: " s", decimals: 2, min: 0.01, max: 36000, quick: [0.25, 0.5, 1, 2],
756	            read: { ReelTime.seconds(current()?.duration ?? 0) },
757	            write: { value in
758	                let seconds = min(value, max(ReelTime.seconds(length()), 0.01))
759	                binding.apply(
760	                    "Resize Action",
761	                    [
762	                        .setAction(
763	                            clip: clipID, action: actionID,
764	                            duration: binding.frameTicks(seconds: seconds))
765	                    ])
766	            },
767	            enabled: { true }, onEdit: { binding.edited() })
768	        duration.toolTip = "How long the action takes"
769	        let glyph = CurveGlyphView(read: { current()?.curve ?? .linear })
770	        let curve = OptionPopupControl(
771	            width: 70, choices: Curve.allCases.map { ($0.laneName, $0) },
772	            read: { current()?.curve ?? .linear },
773	            write: { value in
774	                binding.apply(
775	                    "Action Curve", [.setAction(clip: clipID, action: actionID, curve: value)])
776	            },
777	            enabled: { true }, onEdit: { binding.edited() })
778	        curve.toolTip = "How the action eases from its start to its end state"
779	        let remove = GhostButton(
780	            symbol: "trash", fallback: "×", caption: nil, tooltip: "Remove this action",
781	            action: #selector(removePressed(_:)), size: NSSize(width: 22, height: 22),
782	            pointSize: 13)
783	        remove.target = self
784	        let views: [NSView] = [start, duration, glyph, curve, remove]
785	        for view in views {
786	            view.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
787	            detail.addSubview(view)
788	            view.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: detail.centerYAnchor).isActive = true
789	        }
790	        curve.setContentCompressionResistancePriority(.defaultLow, for: .horizontal)
791	        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
792	            start.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: detail.leadingAnchor),
793	            duration.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: start.trailingAnchor, constant: 5),
794	            glyph.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: duration.trailingAnchor, constant: 5),
795	            curve.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: glyph.trailingAnchor, constant: 3),
796	            curve.trailingAnchor.constraint(lessThanOrEqualTo: remove.leadingAnchor, constant: -5),
797	            remove.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: detail.trailingAnchor),
798	        ])
799	        controls = [start, duration, glyph, curve]
800	    }

803	        inspector?.onCommand?(#selector(EditorViewController.removeSelectedAction(_:)))
804	    }

806	    // MARK: Refresh
807	
808	    func refresh() {
809	        for control in controls { control.refresh() }
810	        let hidden = action == nil
811	        if detail.isHidden != hidden {
812	            detail.isHidden = hidden
813	            invalidateIntrinsicContentSize()
814	        }
815	        needsDisplay = true
816	        let shown = clip  // one snapshot lookup for the two reads below
817	        let key = (
818	            clip: clipID, bands: (shown?.actions ?? []).map { ($0.id, $0.start, $0.duration) },
819	            frame: binding.canvas.fps.frameDuration, length: shown?.duration ?? 0)

821	           old.length == key.length, old.bands.elementsEqual(key.bands, by: ==) { return }

856	    override func draw(_ dirtyRect: NSRect) {
857	        if action != nil {
858	            DS.action.withAlphaComponent(0.07).setFill()
859	            bounds.fill()
860	        }
861	        DS.border.setFill()

882	                "no actions · ⌥⌘K adds one",
883	                in: CGRect(x: lane.minX, y: lane.midY - 7, width: lane.width, height: 14),
884	                font: DS.mono(10), color: DS.textFaint, centered: true)
885	        }
886	        let graph = clip.duration > 0 ? RateGraph.points(
887	            binding.project?.sourceMap(clip.id), in: lane.insetBy(dx: 0, dy: 4),
888	            x: { lane.minX + lane.width * CGFloat($0) / CGFloat(clip.duration) }) : nil
889	        for (index, band) in bandRects().enumerated() where ordered.indices.contains(index) {
890	            let a = ordered[index]
891	            ActionBands.draw(
892	                band: band.rect, number: index + 1, label: nil,

900	            let fraction = CGFloat(clip.clipTime(binding.playhead)) / CGFloat(clip.duration)

902	            NSRect(
903	                x: (lane.minX + lane.width * fraction - 0.5).rounded(), y: lane.minY + 1,
904	                width: 1, height: lane.height - 2
905	            ).fill()
906	        }
907	    }

909	    /// ACTIONS, the count and "· editing N" — or nothing while a drag has
910	    /// moved, when the HUD takes the text's place (`drawDragOverlay`).
911	    private func drawHeaderRow() {
912	        guard drag?.didMove != true else { return }
913	        let row = CGRect(x: Self.side, y: Self.top, width: bounds.width, height: Self.headerRow)
914	        let title = DS.microLabel("Actions")
915	        let titleSize = title.size()
916	        title.draw(at: NSPoint(x: row.minX, y: row.midY - titleSize.height / 2))

919	        let count = clip.actions.isEmpty ? "none" : "\(clip.actions.count)"

921	        if let action = action,
922	            let index = ActionBands.ordered(clip).firstIndex(where: { $0.id == action.id })
923	        {
924	            _ = drawMono("· editing \(index + 1)", at: x + 4, row: row, color: DS.action)
925	        }
926	    }

929	        let attributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
930	            .font: DS.mono(10), .foregroundColor: color,
931	        ]
932	        let size = text.size(withAttributes: attributes)
933	        text.draw(at: NSPoint(x: x, y: row.midY - size.height / 2), withAttributes: attributes)

95	enum ClipSubTab: String, CaseIterable {

102	        case .graphic: return "Graphic"
103	        case .picture: return "Picture"
104	        case .color: return "Color"
105	        case .sound: return "Sound"
106	        case .clip: return "Clip"
107	        }
108	    }

110	    /// The `◆N` badge (spec §11 CI-6): how many KEYS of an action's end patch
111	    /// this tab's sections write. Motion lives on Clip, so Picture counts the
112	    /// video keys without it; a shape's props are not animatable; Graphic
113	    /// counts the end's `graphic.props`, a key its module no longer declares
114	    /// included (CI-6 amended, G-34 (l)). Color counts `color`, one key
115	    /// however many of its thirteen the end names, and Picture no longer does
116	    /// (CI-6 amended by GR-2); for an all-adjustment selection (`adjustment`)
117	    /// it also counts `opacity`, the Adjustment section's Strength (GR-6). An
118	    /// end's `look` is Color's too, one key (GR-7), and so is its `wheels`,
119	    /// one key however many of its nine it names (GR-11), and its `curves`,
120	    /// one key however many channels it names (GR-12), and its `qualifier`,
121	    /// one key however many ranges it names (GR-13); Picture counts none of
122	    /// them. Clip also counts an end's `speed`, the Speed section's Rate (CI-6
123	    /// amended by SR-21).
124	    func keyedCount(in end: ActionPatch, adjustment: Bool = false) -> Int {
125	        switch self {
126	        case .text: return end.text?.dictionary.count ?? 0
127	        case .shape: return 0
128	        case .graphic: return end.graphic?.props.count ?? 0
129	        case .picture:
130	            let other: Set<String> = ["motion", "color", "look", "wheels", "curves", "qualifier"]
131	            return end.video?.dictionary.keys.filter { !other.contains($0) }.count ?? 0
132	        case .color:
133	            return (end.video?.color?.isEmpty == false ? 1 : 0)
134	                + (end.video?.dictionary["look"] != nil ? 1 : 0)
135	                + (end.video?.wheels?.isEmpty == false ? 1 : 0)
136	                + (end.video?.curves?.isEmpty == false ? 1 : 0)
137	                + (end.video?.qualifier?.isEmpty == false ? 1 : 0)
138	                + (adjustment && end.video?.dictionary["opacity"] != nil ? 1 : 0)
139	        case .sound: return end.audio?.dictionary.count ?? 0
140	        case .clip:
141	            return (end.video?.dictionary["motion"] == nil ? 0 : 1) + (end.speed == nil ? 0 : 1)

143	    }

417	    /// The single-clip name line, typed into. It shows what the strip shows
418	    /// (`name(of:)` — own name or fallback), so what you read is what you
419	    /// edit, and commits the clip's OWN name: the trimmed text, or `null` for

421	    /// Emptying a field that already showed the fallback has nothing to
422	    /// clear: no op is sent (the core's refusal would only beep). Either way
423	    /// the field re-reads the model as the commit ends — `InspectorNameField`
424	    /// sets itself directly there, because its `refresh` is skipped while
425	    /// the field editor is attached, which it still is at that point.
426	    private func installNameField(for id: UInt32) {
427	        let binding = self.binding
428	        /// Read fresh through the captured id, never captured itself: a
429	        /// rename REPLACES the clip snapshot, and the header is refreshed.
430	        func clip() -> ClipSnapshot? { binding.snapshot.clip(id) }
431	        let field = InspectorNameField(
432	            read: { clip().map { binding.snapshot.name(of: $0) } ?? "" },
433	            write: { value in
434	                let trimmed = value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
435	                if trimmed.isEmpty, clip()?.name == nil { return }
436	                let patch = ClipPatch(name: .some(trimmed.isEmpty ? nil : trimmed))
437	                binding.apply("Rename Clip", [.setClip(clips: [id], patch: patch)])
438	            },
439	            enabled: { clip() != nil },
440	            onEdit: { binding.edited() })
441	        field.font = DS.sans(12, weight: .semibold)
442	        field.toolTip = "The clip's own name — empty it to go back to what the clip shows"
443	        // The field pins its own `DS.controlHeight` height; the one
444	        // constraint is re-pinned rather than fought with a second.
445	        for constraint in field.constraints
446	        where constraint.firstItem === field && constraint.firstAttribute == .height {
447	            constraint.constant = Self.fieldHeight
448	        }
449	        field.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false
450	        addSubview(field)
451	        let trailing = field.trailingAnchor.constraint(
452	            equalTo: trailingAnchor, constant: -InspectorMetrics.inset)
453	        NSLayoutConstraint.activate([
454	            field.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: leadingAnchor, constant: Self.nameLeft),
455	            field.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: topAnchor, constant: Self.fieldTop),
456	            trailing,
457	        ])
458	        nameTrailing = trailing
459	        nameField = field
460	    }
